# ESP FlashJS hardware fixture — one region, kept for one reason
chip:      ESP32-S3
captured:  2026-08-19
sketch:    tools/fixture-device/fixture_device/fixture_device.ino
layout:    tools/fixture-device/fixture_device/partitions.csv

Not a normal fixture. This is the ffat partition of a board that had been
provisioned several times rather than once from an erased chip, so its
wear-levelling layer had moved the spare sector on. The root directory sits
unshifted at physical sector 3 while the data region is shifted by one, and
that combination is what the old detection could not see: the root looked
right under "no shift", so it stopped there and /sub/nested.txt disappeared
without a single issue being reported.

Kept so that cannot come back. See test/fat.test.js.
